name: Pricing Table — Sharp Glassmorphism
description: Frosted-glass three-tier SaaS pricing table floating over an animated gradient mesh — translucent panels with backdrop blur, luminous top edge highlights, a gradient CTA on the popular tier with a cyan glow badge, check/dash feature lists, and a working monthly/annual billing toggle that swaps the displayed prices live. Hover lift states add depth to the glass cards.
features: highlighted popular tier with gradient CTA and cyan glow badge
